---
title: "CTCF ChIP-seq statistics and source data"
output: html_document
---

Statistical tests of the CTCF ChIP-seq signal at the FAM111A and CDC37 CTCF elements, and source-data
tables for the CTCF figures.

The signal values (mean CPM over the 301-bp tested element in each library's bigWig) come from
`analyses/2026-06-29_CTCF_ChIP_validation/ctcf_signal_from_bigwigs.py` and are plotted in
`analyses/2026-06-30_CTCF_Plots/plots_for_paper.Rmd`. This notebook does not recompute the signal. It
tests the plotted values and writes the source-data tables to `source_data/`.

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(here)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(GenomicRanges)
})
source(here("scripts", "R", "utils.R"))

source_data_dir <- here("analyses", "2026-10-23_ctcf_and_validation_statistics", "source_data")
dir.create(source_data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Inputs

```{r load-inputs}
signal_df <- fread(here("analyses", "2026-06-29_CTCF_ChIP_validation", "source_data", "ctcf_signal_per_replicate.tsv"))
libraries <- fread(here("metadata", "ctcf_chip_libraries.tsv"), na.strings = c("", "NA"))
guides_bed <- fread(
  here("analyses", "2026-06-30_CTCF_Plots", "chip_sgrnas_hg38.bed"),
  col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "thick_start", "thick_end", "rgb")
)
motifs_jaspar <- fread(
  here("analyses", "2026-06-29_CTCF_ChIP_validation", "CTCF_jaspar_motifs.bed"),
  col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand")
)
motifs_plot <- fread(
  here("analyses", "2026-06-30_CTCF_Plots", "ctcf_element_motifs_hg38.bed"),
  col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "thick_start", "thick_end", "rgb")
)

signal_df
```

The two control lines both carry non-targeting sgRNAs:

```{r control-description}
unique(libraries[intended_target == "control", .(group, sgrna, sgrna_oligo_id)])
```

## Library annotation

```{r annotate-libraries}
sgrna_labels <- c(
  G2 = "FAM111A sgRNA G2", G3 = "FAM111A sgRNA G3",
  G4 = "CDC37 sgRNA G4", G6 = "CDC37 sgRNA G6",
  NC2 = "Non-targeting NC2", WTC11_NT = "Non-targeting NT1"
)

annotated <- merge(
  signal_df,
  libraries[, .(sample_id, sequencing_library, pf_fragments, sgrna, sgrna_oligo_id, sgrna_hg38)],
  by = "sample_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
annotated[, control_status := ifelse(intended_target == "control", "non-targeting control", "targeting")]
annotated[, test_group := ifelse(intended_target == "control", "Pooled NT controls (NC2 + NT1)", sgrna)]

stopifnot(!anyNA(annotated$sequencing_library), nrow(annotated) == 36)
```

## Sample sizes

Each value is one CTCF ChIP-seq library (one ChIP replicate of one sgRNA line). Within each locus:

```{r sample-sizes}
sample_sizes <- annotated[
  ,
  .(
    n_libraries = .N,
    median_cpm = median(mean_signal),
    mean_cpm = mean(mean_signal),
    sd_cpm = sd(mean_signal)
  ),
  by = .(locus_label, locus, sgrna)
][order(locus_label, sgrna)]
knitr::kable(sample_sizes, digits = 3)
```

## Guide-level tests

Each targeting sgRNA (n = 3 ChIP libraries) is compared with the pooled non-targeting controls
(NC2 + NT1; n = 6 ChIP libraries; the replicate values of the two control lines are combined into one
group without averaging) at the sgRNA's intended locus, using a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
With n < 50 per group and no ties, R's `wilcox.test()` computes the exact null distribution by default;
`exact = TRUE` is set explicitly here. The asymptotic p-value (normal approximation with continuity
correction) is shown for reference only.

```{r guide-level-tests}
run_wilcoxon <- function(test_values, control_values) {
  exact_test <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(
    test_values, control_values,
    alternative = "two.sided", exact = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95
  ))
  asymptotic_test <- wilcox.test(
    test_values, control_values,
    alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE
  )
  data.table(
    n_test = length(test_values),
    n_control = length(control_values),
    median_test_cpm = median(test_values),
    median_control_cpm = median(control_values),
    fold_change_of_means = mean(test_values) / mean(control_values),
    W = unname(exact_test$statistic),
    test_method = exact_test$method,
    p_exact_two_sided = exact_test$p.value,
    p_asymptotic_two_sided = asymptotic_test$p.value,
    hodges_lehmann_shift_cpm = unname(exact_test$estimate),
    shift_ci_lower = exact_test$conf.int[1],
    shift_ci_upper = exact_test$conf.int[2],
    shift_ci_level = attr(exact_test$conf.int, "conf.level"),
    min_attainable_p = 2 / choose(length(test_values) + length(control_values), length(test_values))
  )
}

values_for <- function(locus, guides = NULL, targets = NULL) {
  rows <- annotated$locus_label == locus
  if (!is.null(guides)) rows <- rows & annotated$guide %in% guides
  if (!is.null(targets)) rows <- rows & annotated$intended_target %in% targets
  annotated$mean_signal[rows]
}

guide_comparisons <- data.table(
  locus_label = c("FAM111A_peak", "FAM111A_peak", "CDC37_peak", "CDC37_peak"),
  guide = c("G2", "G3", "G4", "G6")
)

guide_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(guide_comparisons)), function(i) {
  cmp <- guide_comparisons[i]
  cbind(cmp, run_wilcoxon(values_for(cmp$locus_label, guides = cmp$guide), values_for(cmp$locus_label, targets = "control")))
}))
guide_tests[, comparison := paste(sgrna_labels[guide], "vs pooled NT controls")]
guide_tests[, direction := ifelse(median_test_cpm < median_control_cpm, "lower than controls", "higher than controls")]
guide_tests[, p_holm_4_guides := p.adjust(p_exact_two_sided, method = "holm")]
guide_tests[, p_bh_4_guides := p.adjust(p_exact_two_sided, method = "BH")]
guide_tests[, family := "guide-level (4 tests)"]

knitr::kable(
  guide_tests[, .(comparison, n_test, n_control, median_test_cpm, median_control_cpm, fold_change_of_means,
                  W, test_method, p_exact_two_sided, p_asymptotic_two_sided, p_holm_4_guides, p_bh_4_guides,
                  direction)],
  digits = 4
)
```

With 3 vs 6 observations the exact two-sided test cannot return a p-value below
`r signif(2 / choose(9, 3), 3)` (complete separation of the two groups). The smallest Holm threshold
for four tests is 0.05 / 4 = 0.0125, so no guide-level comparison can be declared significant after
Holm (or Bonferroni) correction with this design, regardless of effect size. G3 (FAM111A) and G6
(CDC37) both reach this floor, in opposite directions.

## Locus-level tests (both sgRNAs pooled)

Both targeting sgRNAs at a locus (n = 6 libraries) vs the pooled non-targeting controls (n = 6),
Holm-adjusted across the two loci.

```{r locus-level-tests}
locus_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(c("FAM111A_peak", "CDC37_peak"), function(locus) {
  cbind(
    data.table(locus_label = locus),
    run_wilcoxon(values_for(locus, targets = sub("_peak$", "", locus)), values_for(locus, targets = "control"))
  )
}))
locus_tests[, guide := ifelse(locus_label == "FAM111A_peak", "G2+G3", "G4+G6")]
locus_tests[, comparison := paste(sub("_peak$", "", locus_label), "sgRNAs (both) vs pooled NT controls")]
locus_tests[, direction := ifelse(median_test_cpm < median_control_cpm, "lower than controls", "higher than controls")]
locus_tests[, p_holm_2_loci := p.adjust(p_exact_two_sided, method = "holm")]
locus_tests[, family := "locus-level (2 tests)"]

knitr::kable(
  locus_tests[, .(comparison, n_test, n_control, fold_change_of_means, W, p_exact_two_sided, p_holm_2_loci, direction)],
  digits = 4
)
```

## Sensitivity analyses

### The two control lines

```{r control-lines}
control_lines <- annotated[intended_target == "control", .(mean_cpm = mean(mean_signal), sd_cpm = sd(mean_signal), n = .N), by = .(locus_label, sgrna)]
knitr::kable(control_lines, digits = 3)

control_line_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(c("FAM111A_peak", "CDC37_peak"), function(locus) {
  cbind(
    data.table(locus_label = locus, comparison = "NC2 vs NT1"),
    run_wilcoxon(values_for(locus, guides = "NC2"), values_for(locus, guides = "WTC11_NT"))
  )
}))
knitr::kable(control_line_tests[, .(locus_label, comparison, n_test, n_control, fold_change_of_means, p_exact_two_sided, min_attainable_p)], digits = 4)
```

### Each targeting sgRNA against each control line separately

With 3 vs 3 libraries the smallest attainable exact two-sided p-value is 0.1, so only the direction
and size of the difference are informative.

```{r per-control}
per_control <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(guide_comparisons)), function(i) {
  cmp <- guide_comparisons[i]
  test_values <- values_for(cmp$locus_label, guides = cmp$guide)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("NC2", "WTC11_NT"), function(control_guide) {
    control_values <- values_for(cmp$locus_label, guides = control_guide)
    data.table(
      locus_label = cmp$locus_label,
      sgrna = sgrna_labels[[cmp$guide]],
      control = sgrna_labels[[control_guide]],
      fold_change_of_means = mean(test_values) / mean(control_values),
      n_test_below_all_controls = sum(test_values < min(control_values)),
      n_test_above_all_controls = sum(test_values > max(control_values))
    )
  }))
}))
knitr::kable(per_control, digits = 3)
```

### Welch t-test on log2 CPM (parametric complement)

```{r welch}
welch_tests <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(guide_comparisons)), function(i) {
  cmp <- guide_comparisons[i]
  welch <- t.test(
    log2(values_for(cmp$locus_label, guides = cmp$guide)),
    log2(values_for(cmp$locus_label, targets = "control")),
    var.equal = FALSE
  )
  cbind(cmp, data.table(
    log2_fold_change = unname(welch$estimate[1] - welch$estimate[2]),
    ci_lower = welch$conf.int[1],
    ci_upper = welch$conf.int[2],
    p_welch = welch$p.value
  ))
}))
welch_tests[, p_holm_4_guides := p.adjust(p_welch, method = "holm")]
knitr::kable(welch_tests, digits = 4)
```

### Specificity: lines targeting the other locus

At each peak, the lines that target the other locus (on a different chromosome) are an additional
set of controls. A locus-specific effect predicts control-like signal in those lines.

```{r specificity}
specificity <- rbindlist(Map(function(locus, other_target) {
  cbind(
    data.table(locus_label = locus, other_target = other_target),
    run_wilcoxon(values_for(locus, targets = other_target), values_for(locus, targets = "control"))
  )
}, c("FAM111A_peak", "CDC37_peak"), c("CDC37", "FAM111A")))
knitr::kable(
  specificity[, .(locus_label, lines = paste(other_target, "-targeting lines"), n_test, n_control, fold_change_of_means, p_exact_two_sided)],
  digits = 4
)
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
annotated[, sgrna := factor(sgrna, levels = sgrna_labels)]
annotated[, locus_label := factor(locus_label, levels = c("FAM111A_peak", "CDC37_peak"))]
ggplot(annotated, aes(x = sgrna, y = mean_signal, fill = control_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 1), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~locus_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("targeting" = "#009E73", "non-targeting control" = "grey80")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CTCF ChIP-seq signal (mean CPM over element)", fill = NULL)
```

## Per-guide CRISPRi effects (values behind the per-guide effect plots)

The per-guide effect plots in `plots_for_paper.Rmd` use the singleton (per-guide) SCEPTRE results of the
WTC11 screen, with guide positions lifted from hg19 to hg38.

```{r per-guide-effects}
singleton_df <- load_ctcf_element_guide_effects(
  screen_dir = here("..", "results", "process_validation_datasets", "WTC11_DC_TAP_Seq"),
  chain_path = here("data", "hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
)

# Motif centers used for the x-axis of the per-guide plots (ctcf_element_motifs_hg38.bed) and the
# JASPAR 2024 CTCF hits (MA0139.2). The two FAM111A annotations differ by ~10 bp.
motif_center <- function(bed, pattern) {
  hit <- bed[grepl(pattern, name)]
  (hit$start + hit$end) / 2
}
singleton_df[, locus := ifelse(guide_chr == "chr11", "FAM111A", "CDC37")]
singleton_df[, plot_motif_center_hg38 := ifelse(
  locus == "FAM111A",
  motif_center(motifs_plot, "FAM111A_CTCF_Motif"),
  motif_center(motifs_plot, "CDC37_CTCF_Motif_1")
)]
singleton_df[, jaspar_motif_center_hg38 := ifelse(
  locus == "FAM111A",
  motif_center(motifs_jaspar, "FAM111A"),
  motif_center(motifs_jaspar, "CDC37_m1")
)]
singleton_df[, distance_to_plot_motif_center_bp := guide_start_hg38 - plot_motif_center_hg38]
singleton_df[, distance_to_jaspar_motif_center_bp := guide_start_hg38 - jaspar_motif_center_hg38]
singleton_df[, used_for_chip_lines := grna_id %in% libraries$sgrna_oligo_id]

knitr::kable(
  singleton_df[order(locus, guide_start_hg38), .(locus, grna_id, guide_start_hg38, distance_to_plot_motif_center_bp,
                                                 pct_change_effect_size, lower_CI_95_pct_change, upper_CI_95_pct_change,
                                                 p_value, used_for_chip_lines)],
  digits = 3
)
```

## sgRNA overlap with CTCF motifs (hg38, BED intervals)

```{r motif-overlap}
guides_bed[, grna_id := sub("^gRNA_", "WTC11_Random_Screen_", name)]
guide_gr <- GRanges(guides_bed$chr, IRanges(guides_bed$start + 1, guides_bed$end), grna_id = guides_bed$grna_id)
motif_gr <- GRanges(motifs_jaspar$chr, IRanges(motifs_jaspar$start + 1, motifs_jaspar$end), motif = motifs_jaspar$name, motif_score = motifs_jaspar$score)
hits <- findOverlaps(guide_gr, motif_gr)
motif_overlap <- data.table(
  grna_id = guide_gr$grna_id[queryHits(hits)],
  motif = motif_gr$motif[subjectHits(hits)],
  motif_score = motif_gr$motif_score[subjectHits(hits)],
  overlap_bp = width(pintersect(guide_gr[queryHits(hits)], motif_gr[subjectHits(hits)]))
)
knitr::kable(motif_overlap)
```

## Export source data

```{r export}
signal_source <- annotated[
  order(locus_label, sgrna, replicate),
  .(
    locus = locus_label,
    locus_hg38 = locus,
    library = sample_id,
    sequencing_library,
    sgrna,
    sgrna_oligo_id,
    sgrna_hg38,
    intended_target,
    chip_replicate = replicate,
    test_group,
    pf_fragments,
    ctcf_mean_cpm = mean_signal
  )
]
fwrite(signal_source, file.path(source_data_dir, "ctcf_chip_signal_per_library.tsv"), sep = "\t")

test_columns <- c(
  "family", "locus_label", "guide", "comparison", "n_test", "n_control", "median_test_cpm", "median_control_cpm",
  "fold_change_of_means", "W", "test_method", "p_exact_two_sided", "p_asymptotic_two_sided",
  "hodges_lehmann_shift_cpm", "shift_ci_lower", "shift_ci_upper", "shift_ci_level", "min_attainable_p", "direction"
)
all_tests <- rbindlist(
  list(
    guide_tests[, c(test_columns, "p_holm_4_guides", "p_bh_4_guides"), with = FALSE],
    locus_tests[, c(test_columns, "p_holm_2_loci"), with = FALSE]
  ),
  fill = TRUE
)
fwrite(all_tests, file.path(source_data_dir, "ctcf_chip_wilcoxon_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t")

fwrite(
  singleton_df[order(locus, guide_start_hg38)],
  file.path(source_data_dir, "ctcf_elements_per_guide_crispri_effects.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

knitr::kable(all_tests[, .(family, comparison, n_test, n_control, W, p_exact_two_sided, p_holm_4_guides, p_bh_4_guides, p_holm_2_loci)], digits = 4)
```
